description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d_tracer/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc_tracer: the compound D(K*D(u,lev),lev) on a [lev, tracer] state replaced by the rule's makearray (per-tracer interior stencil over [2,7] x [1,3]; per-tracer prescribed-flux faces at k=1 and k=8 reading the [tracer] free names kdudz_bot and kdudz_top; every flux the one interface_flux_K_lev_tracer template). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV=8, NTRACER=3 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST in the esm-spec 9.6.4 reference-preserving form, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
